chapter: Baton Rouge big band and New York
title: Moving to Baton Rouge after Pete Herman
summary: He went to Baton Rouge not long after the war and after the Ringside, but cannot pin down dates.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well when did you go up to Baton Rouge?
Well it wasn't very long after the war was over. It was after Pete Herman.
Yeah it was after Pete Herman you went up there? The Stand It All band?
Yeah I'm talking about dates you know. It's hard to remember dates.

Well don't worry about it we got it down on the pictures. What was that Stand It All band like? Did you fit in there okay? Oh yeah. You didn't have any trouble? It must have been a big band huh? You didn't have to read?
